raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.0.1"
  python_check_max: "3.14"

package:
  name: pytest-lsp
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pytest-lsp/pytest_lsp-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: cd9950fec2991e65364430dd419daeedf546928788f457e1106d5b751aea0be8

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script:
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation --disable-pip-version-check

requirements:
  host:
    - hatchling >=1.17.1
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  run:
    - packaging
    - pygls >=2.0.0
    - pytest >=8
    - pytest-asyncio >=1.0
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports: pytest_lsp
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - ${{ python_check_max }}.*
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
        - pyproject.toml
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest-cov
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - coverage run --source=pytest_lsp --branch -m pytest -vv --tb=long --color=yes
      - coverage report --show-missing --skip-covered --fail-under=88

about:
  summary: A pytest plugin for end-to-end testing of language servers
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://pypi.org/project/pytest-lsp
  repository: https://github.com/swyddfa/lsp-devtools/tree/develop/lib/pytest-lsp
  documentation: https://lsp-devtools.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - bollwyvl
